name: Oni Harami no Gakuen ~Sukumizu Shoujo Ishukan Ryoujoku Geki~
original_name: 鬼孕の学園～スク水少女異種姦凌辱劇～
source:
An academy located deep within the mountains and surrounded by nature.
There are approximately 500 students at this originally all boys academy.
This year it became co-ed and our heroines Rin and Mayu newly
transfer to the school... only for something absolutely abnormal to occur!

The students are turning into monsters and the school has
transformed into a tentacle writhing cesspool of downright decadence...

Behold and revel in the hard core tentacle play and situations!

[From DLsite English]
translation:
一所学院坐落在群山深处，四周为大自然环抱。
这所原本只招收男生的学院约有500名学生。
今年，学校开始男女同校，女主人公相摩凛与孕茧也刚刚
转入这里……没想到某种极不正常的异变就此发生！

学生们正在变成怪物，整座学校也已沦为
触手翻涌、堕落至极的污秽魔窟……

亲眼见证并尽情享受硬核触手玩法与各种情境吧！
